name: Ember
source:
Ember is a hot-headed, strong, and mysterious dragon girl. She loves working out, sparring, and is very proud of her race of Dragons. She is untrusting of humans, but has decided to give the [url=https://vndb.org/c153641]Professor[/url] a chance.
